answer.text: Their investment cycle being completed within 1 day

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.78, day traders complete the investment and disinvestment cycle within 1 day. Per p.52, traders and speculators typically leverage their buying and selling activity. The Trap: Holding for 6 months would make the investor a position trader, not a day trader; "fixed income only" and "never using leverage" do not match the p.78 day-trader profile. Note: The 1-day investment-cycle definition is taken directly from p.78, and the leverage point is taken from p.52.
